messages.businessImpact: Any executable a user can obtain will run. Application control is the difference between an attachment being opened and an attachment being executed.
remediation: Start with App Control for Business in audit mode using the Microsoft-signed base policy.
Review what audit reports for several weeks before enforcing.
Treat this as a project rather than a setting.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a Settings Catalog policy exists is read, not whether it works. SEC-033 checks whether one exists but reaches no device. Legacy intents are not counted here: their documented template subtype does not identify application control, so this rule may report absence in an estate with a legacy application control intent.
